Addiction

Sorry for the inactivity..I was working on this video haha.
Hope you guys enjoy this one. It's my first time working with a theme/storyline. The ending is a bit raw, and I kinda lost interest in the end. (Mainly b/c I have summer classes and I wanna move on with some other vids I have ideas for)

Huuuuge thanks to everyone who beta tested. I made lots of changes thanks to you guys and I like how it turned out. I also apologize to Deb for beta testing just a few hours ago and me being too lazy to make any major changes.

I love when Vegas lags so much that you can't even preview the video because you have so much stuff going on. And don't even talk to me about After Effects for that matter. ;)

Anyway, enjoy. I'll be able to get back to uploading a few AMVlogs now. :D
